WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref,
    st.entrystat,
    AVG(s.memusagegb) AS avg_ram_gb,
    AVG(s.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(s.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.entrystat
)
SELECT
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram_gb) AS avg_per_site_ram_gb,
  AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_per_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM per_site
GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: GPU/CPU ratio is computed per processing run, excluding missing CPU or GPU values and CPU values of zero, then averaged within each site; the site-level averages are averaged equally within each access status.
